messages:
eli: Handoff time — I'm handing primary to @priya for the 08:00-16:00 PST window. Quick notes before I go offline: I discovered I don't have the PagerDuty escalation policy view for APAC, and my Grafana 'prod-inference' dashboard is throwing 403s. Leaving runbook pointers below.
priya: Copy. I'm secondary. Can you paste the runbook link and the PD escalation policy name? I'll verify my access now.
eli: Runbook -> https://docs.internal.redwood-inference.com/runbooks/oncall-prod-inference. PD policy is 'Prod-Inference-All-Regions-escalate'. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood-inference.com/d/redwood/prod-inference (error shows 403 for me).
priya: Trying to open PD policy — I can see it but not the rotation details. Getting "insufficient permissions" when viewing schedules.
samir: Heads up — calendar shows a gap 12:30-13:15 PST because @kevin put a placeholder vacation. Who covers that slot if an incident pages?
eli: For the gap, fallback plan is to page the oncall-backup rotation (PagerDuty ID: PDR-ONCALL-BACKUP). If that fails, escalate to Kevin directly. I left contact in the runbook.
priya: On Grafana — I can open dashboards but panels that pull from the inference-cluster namespace are returning 500. Could be role-based filtering.
ops-bot: incident-bot created incident INC-2026-1042: "High 95th latency on hostpool gpt-512" — pages sent to prod-inference-primary.
incident-bot: Auto-detected impact: partial for EU/US. APAC not yet evaluated. See incident timeline in ops dashboard.
priya: Got the page. I'm running quick checks: `kubectl get pods -n inference --selector=app=runtime --field-selector=status.phase!=Running`
priya: Logs show repeated `CUDA OOM` on node gpu-14. Pulling node metrics now.
samir: If it's node-level OOM, consider toggling the autoscaler policy to drain new long requests. Runbook step: "evacuate-node-oom" -> link above.
eli: For PagerDuty access fixes: ticket template is in runbook; short version: request Okta group `oncall-access` + IAM assume role `arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/OncallAssumeRole` for AWS console. Use admin-ops for immediate approvals.
priya: I don't have the AWS assume role available under my profile — `sts:AssumeRole` denied. I'll ping infra to open the role.
kevin: I'm online now — I can take manual escalations during that midday gap if needed. Priya, if PD rotation fails, DM me and I'll acknowledge and forward.
priya: Infra ticket created: #INFRA-4529 — asked for `sts:AssumeRole` to the OncallAssumeRole and Grafana org viewer role. ETA ~20m.
ops-bot: FYI — added priya to PagerDuty schedule view (limited) at 1768001290. Full escalation rights pending.
priya: Can someone confirm the exact Grafana org role needed? I see docs mention `Viewer` vs `Editor`. I only need Viewer + ability to see data source.
eli: Viewer + `datasource-reader` role on Grafana. The request flow is via Okta group `grafana-viewers`.
samir: Noted — I'll update the runbook step to include the precise Okta groups and the infra ticket template. Small change but it'll save time.
priya: For now, I'll monitor the incident from the PD mobile app. If infra can't get AWS role, I can't verify node drain commands myself.
eli: One more thing — if you're missing PD pages entirely, quick check: open https://pagerduty.com/users and confirm your email is in the schedule. If pages are still missing, force test by triggering `opsbot test-page --rotation prod-inference-primary` (runbook has that snippet).
kevin: Also, remember to add me to the secondary contact list in the runbook for the 12:30–13:15 gap.
priya: Acknowledged. I'll also add a short note in the runbook that if infra is delayed >30m, escalate to Kevin immediately.
priya: Update — infra confirmed they granted the assume role and Grafana datasources access. I can see node metrics now and initiated a soft drain on gpu-14 (runbook step executed).
ops-bot: incident-bot updated INC-2026-1042 status -> Mitigating at 1768001299.
eli: Thanks all. Leaving primary handed off to Priya. I'll be reachable on DM for 30m. If anything looks stuck, escalate to Kevin.
priya: Thanks Eli. I'll own it. Leaving a quick checklist in the runbook: 1) verify PD schedule 2) confirm Grafana datasource 3) assume AWS role 4) follow 'evacuate-node-oom' steps.
kevin: Thanks. Ping me if PD rotation doesn't show up or if infra says they can't grant role.
ops-bot: Auto-note: please run the post-handoff verification checklist in the runbook within 10 minutes of handoff to avoid coverage gaps.
